name: Athens
about: Peak summer (Jul–Aug) is scorching, best avoided for serious sightseeing; spring and fall are far more comfortable for walking the ancient sites.
overview: The Acropolis and the world's greatest classical antiquity, paired with a vibrant food and nightlife scene — the Saronic islands a short ferry away.
costOverview: Affordable for food and transit — the Acropolis and its surrounding museums are the one real must-pay expense.
